agent: occupation and revolt wave, reader E (undergrounds and partisans)
question: Undergrounds: where they come from, how they grow and are found, and how an exile mobilises them - the underground pass 0x50A110 on the listing, a new underground 0x50BD00, the initial strength 0x509050/0x509230, the commands and screens that set underground_action, the AI's use, the underground building's levels, and the bypass byte 0x1A85599.

addresses.name: RunDailyUndergroundPass
addresses.comment: **A country's undergrounds, once a day.** 0x50A110 to the single `ret 4` at 0x50AE32, read whole on the listing. Called from RunCountryDailyPass at 0x4DBB64, right after 0x507630 and before the revolt roll (0x4DBBC2). The two defines are read once at the top: UNDERGROUND_STRENGTH_GAIN (military +0x258) and UNDERGROUND_DETECT_CHANCE (military +0x25C). It walks `underground_provinces` (CCountry +0xD60, province ids, `next` at +8) in list order, and for each province, in this order: (1) **growth**, every day and before anything else: gain = (values[LOCAL_PARTISAN_SUPPORT] ([+0x114]+0x260) * 10 / 1000 + 1000) * GAIN / 1000, both steps 64-bit and truncated (the 10 is floor(10.5f) at 0x160A680); underground->level_current (+0x30C, +0x24) += gain, capped at level_max (+0x20), dirty byte +0x28 = changed. (2) **detection**: threshold = fistp( float(suppression (+0x28) * CHANCE / 1000) / 1000.0 ), i.e. round-to-nearest of suppression*CHANCE/1e6 in thousandths; one inlined MT19937 draw (0x50A338), and `draw % 1000 < threshold` is detected. A detected province goes on a stack removal list (0x10-byte nodes) and, at once, a message is raised to the **local player only**: OURUNDERGROUNDREMOVED where the country is the player (gs +0xC34), else UNDERGROUNDREMOVED where the province's controller (+0x338) is the player, else none; variables are CCountry::BuildMessageVariables of the player plus COUNTRY = the province owner's name and PROV = the province's name; posted through PostMessage_CMessageHandler. A detected province does nothing else today. (3) otherwise, **a province whose controller is its owner** (+0x338 == +0x330 - the province's owner, not the underground's) goes on the same removal list with **no message**. (4) otherwise the switch on underground_action (+0x394) at 0x50AC4E: 0 - CanMobilizePartisans, and the province is pushed on a vector; 1 - CanSpawnUnderground, then SpawnUndergroundFromProvince at once (inside the walk); 2 or anything else - nothing. After the walk: SpawnPartisansFromUnderground(country, province) for each collected province, in collection order (0x50AD08); then for each removed province: SetProvinceBuildingLevel(province, the underground definition (g_CBuildingDataBase +0x28), 0, false), CList_RemoveNode of its id from +0xD60, underground_owner (+0x38C) = '---' with id 0, level_current and level_max = 0, and the province template's byte +0x20 = 1.
addresses.evidence: Every instruction from 0x50A110 to 0x50AE32 read in order: the define loads at 0x50A1B7/0x50A1CB, the growth arithmetic at 0x50A278-0x50A2E3 with 0xB99AF0/0xB99980 and the cap at 0x50A2D8, the detection at 0x50A2EC-0x50A3DF (0x10624DD3 is the /1000 of the remainder, `idiv 0x270` is the MT index wrap), `jge 0x50abfe` skipping a non-detected province, the player tests `cmp [edi+0xca8], [gs+0xc34]` at 0x50A82C and `cmp eax,[esi+0x338]` at 0x50A9EE, the strings at 0x50A85F/0x50AA21, the owner==controller test at 0x50ABFE, the switch at 0x50AC4E, the partisan loop 0x50AD00-0x50AD11 and the removal loop 0x50AD1E-0x50ADF3. Wrong if a jump target past 0x50AE32 belongs to this frame (none found: the next bytes are int3 and 0x50AE40 is its own function with its own caller 0x6BB6A1).
addresses.revises: The record had no signature and an outline. Added the signature (one stack argument, ret 4), the order (growth before detection; a detected underground skips the liberation test and the switch that day; spreading happens inside the walk, partisans after it, removal last), who is told (only the local player, as owner or as controller) and that the liberation removal sends no message and tests the province's owner, not the underground's owner.

addresses.name: SpawnPartisansFromUnderground
addresses.comment: **Mobilises a province's underground into partisan brigades.** ret 8. It picks a *neighbour* to put them in: a random edge of the source's path node (+0xD4, edges +0x90..+0x94, stride 0x14) whose province is in a real area (+0x2B4 slot 0) and has the **same owner id** (+0x330); failing that the first qualifying edge in order; failing that the source province itself, and if even that is in no real area it logs `Failed to spawn partisant from underground at location` (country.cpp) and does nothing. Then ChooseRebelTypeForProvince(GetRebelTypeDatabase(), target, allowTriggeredOnly 1, &owner->tag) picks the rebel type and CreateRebelBrigadesInProvince(target, that type, UNDERGROUND_SPAWN_STRENGTH/1000, 1, &owner->tag) makes the brigades. Finally it **charges SPAWN_PARTISAN_LIMIT levels to the source province's underground building** (+0x30C, level_current +0x24), floored at 0, setting that building's dirty byte +0x28 when the level moved. **The first argument is the underground's owner, whoever that is**: its callers are RunDailyUndergroundPass (the country whose list it is) and CSpawnPartisanCommand::Execute (the province's underground_owner), and neither asks whether that country is in exile.
addresses.evidence: Callers by findRefs --callers (0x50AD08, 0x55BFDA), neither with an exile test on the path (CanMobilizePartisans and CSpawnPartisanCommand::IsValid read on the listing). The pushes at 0x50B90E-0x50B92B: &[ebp+8]+0xCA4 twice, 1, the count, the database, `add esp,4` dropping the stray push after the ret 0x10 of 0x4C0430. The fallback walk (0x50B7A0-0x50B86C) tests each edge's own province, unlike SpawnUndergroundFromProvince's.
addresses.revises: The first parameter was named `exile`; it is the underground's owner and nothing requires an exile. 0x4C0430 picks the rebel type (ChooseRebelTypeForProvince), not the faction; the rest of the comment stands.

addresses.name: CanMobilizePartisans
addresses.comment: 0x50B450, bare ret, register convention. True when the province's id (+0xD0) is on country->underground_provinces (+0xD60) **and** either g_ignore_partisan_spawn_limit is set or underground->level_current >= SPAWN_PARTISAN_LIMIT (military +0x248; 0.5 in Their Finest Hour). Six callers: RunDailyUndergroundPass 0x50AC7A, CSpawnPartisanCommand::IsValid 0x55C229, the province view's spawn button 0x6E16FF/0x6E174F, and 0x6EAD51/0x6EAD92 (the spawn_partisan button's enabling). The AI (AI_ManageUndergrounds) inlines the same test at 0x88A4C7.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x50B450-0x50B497: list walk on [eax+0xd60] comparing [esi+0xd0], `cmp byte [0x1a85599],0` at 0x50B46E, `cmp [edx+0x24], [define+0x248]; setge al` at 0x50B491. Callers by findRefs --callers (six). Wrong if a caller passes the country somewhere other than EAX - the six all load EAX first.

No bypass byte. Six callers: RunDailyUndergroundPass 0x50AC61, CSpawnUndergroundCommand::IsValid 0x55C529, the province view 0x6E170E/0x6E1766, 0x6EAEB1/0x6EAEF2.

addresses.name: SpawnUndergroundFromProvince
addresses.comment: **Spreads an underground into one neighbour.** 0x50BD00 to the `ret 4` at 0x50C0A8, read whole. One Random() (0x50BD8D) % the number of the source path node's edges (+0xD4, +0x90..+0x94, stride 0x14) picks a neighbour; it is taken when its underground's level_max (+0x30C, +0x20) is 0 or less **and** its owner id (+0x330) equals the source's owner id. **Otherwise nothing happens and nothing is paid**: the fallback walk over the edges (0x50BE70) loads each edge's province but tests the random neighbour's building and owner again on every pass, so it can never succeed. On success: target level_max += 1000 capped at definition->max_allowed_level*1000 (and at 0 below), CProvinceBuilding_OnLevelChanged; target level_current += UNDERGROUND_SPAWN_STRENGTH (military +0x264, 0.2), capped at level_max; target underground_owner = the source's; the province id pushed onto that country's underground_provinces; then source level_current -= SPAWN_UNDERGROUND_LIMIT (military +0x24C), floored at 0, dirty byte set. No test of the target's controller, its area or its simulated flag, and the template byte +0x20 is not set. Callers: RunDailyUndergroundPass 0x50AC6D (action 1) and CSpawnUndergroundCommand::Execute 0x55C39A.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x50BD00-0x50C0A8: the draw and `idiv esi` at 0x50BD8D-0x50BD93; the first test at 0x50BE39-0x50BE54; the loop 0x50BE70-0x50BEA6 reading `[ebx+0x20]` with ebx = [ebp-0x18] (the random neighbour's building, restored at 0x50BE9A) and `[ebp-0x14]+0x330` (the random neighbour) while the edge's province only goes to [ebp-0x1C]; the success path 0x50BEC8-0x50C006; the cost at 0x50C067-0x50C095. Wrong if ebx or [ebp-0x14] were rewritten inside the loop - they are not.
addresses.revises: Was likely, body unread, named from its position. Read whole: the name holds; added the signature, the neighbour rule, the dead fallback, the levels, the owner and the cost.

addresses.name: GetMobilizeUndergroundsAvailability

Not in exile (+0x95 clear): WE_NOT_GOVERNMENT_IN_EXILE. In exile: over underground_provinces (+0xD60), total counts those the country **owns** (+0x330 == +0xCA8) and ready those of them with level_current **strictly above** SPAWN_PARTISAN_LIMIT; ready 0 (or no list) gives UNDERGROUNDS_NOT_PREPARED with TOTAL = total, otherwise Underground_ReadyToRiseText (0x511690): UNDERGROUNDS_READY_TO_RISE with VAL = ready and TOTAL = total. 0x50B1E0 is not a text variant: it is CCountry_MobilizeAllUndergrounds, what the button does.

addresses.name: g_ignore_partisan_spawn_limit
addresses.comment: One byte, 0 at start. Toggled by the console command `alwayspartisants` (alias `ap`, help 'Toggles ability to always spawn partisants from undergrounds.'), handler Console_AlwaysPartisans (rva 0x3A980), which answers 'Always underground spawn ON' / 'OFF' and refuses any argument with 'Invalid arguments.'. Read by CanMobilizePartisans (0x50B46E) and by the AI's inlined copy of it (0x88A4DD): when set, an underground on its owner's list counts as ready at any level. CanSpawnUnderground and every tooltip ignore it.

The handler's address is in the console table at 0x170AFF0 beside the strings at 0x15B78EC ('alwayspartisants'), 0x15B78E8 ('ap') and 0x15B78A8 (the help).

addresses.name: Underground_FindNearestAirBase
addresses.comment: **The nearest air base a new underground can be supplied from.** ret 8. Over country->AirBases (+0xD70) and then, for each country on country->Allies (+0xF88), that country's AirBases: the base whose province centre (CMap +0x2A60 template +0x2C/+0x30, x wrapped at half the map width +0x2A74) gives 16*(dx*dx+dy*dy) **strictly below** the best so far; the best starts at (MAX_UNDERGROUND_DISTANCE/1000)^2 (military +0x250; 1000 in Their Finest Hour, so within 1000 of CMap::DistanceBetweenProvinces's units). Returns null when none is that close. First of equals wins; own bases are tried before allies'. One caller, Underground_GetInitialStrength.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x509050-0x50921F: the define at 0x509067 divided by 1000 and squared at 0x509080, the two loops 0x5090DD and 0x5091B8 with `shl eax, 4` and `jge` (strict), the allies walk on +0xF88 with node next at +0xC. AirBases is the Lua API's name for +0xD70.

addresses.name: Underground_GetInitialStrength
addresses.signature: int* __stdcall Underground_GetInitialStrength(CMapProvince* province@ECX, CCountry* builder@EAX, int* out@stack:4) @EAX
addresses.comment: **What a new underground starts at.** ret 4. A government in exile (+0x95) building in a province it owns (+0x330 == +0xCA8): UNDERGOUND_INITIAL_STRENGTH (military +0x254, 0.4) flat. Otherwise the nearest air base (Underground_FindNearestAirBase); none gives 0; else d = CMap::DistanceBetweenProvinces(base, province), r = d*1000*1000/MAX_UNDERGROUND_DISTANCE (-1 when the define is 0), and the strength is (1000 - r) * INITIAL / 1000, 64-bit, truncated - 0.4 at the base falling to nothing at the edge. Callers: CBuildingConstruction::Deliver 0x485D7A, CBuildingDeployment::DeployAt 0x57E74F, and the placement map colouring 0x867CC6. CCountry_CanTrainUnderground is the production button's test, not this.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x509230-0x509334: the exile test at 0x509233-0x50924D, `call 0x509050` with (country, province) pushed, `call 0x492030` with the ids in EAX/EDX and the map pushed, the divide at 0x5092C6-0x509300, `(1000 - r) * INITIAL` and 0xB99980 at 0x509302-0x509314. The three callers load ECX = province and EAX = country before the call.

addresses.name: CCountry_MobilizeAllUndergrounds
addresses.comment: **An exile's Organized Revolt.** ret 4; one caller, CSpawnFullRevoltCommand::Execute (0x55C6C2), so it runs on every peer. Collects, in list order, every province on underground_provinces (+0xD60) that the country owns and whose level_current is strictly above SPAWN_PARTISAN_LIMIT; then for each builds a CSpawnPartisanCommand on the stack and, where its IsValid holds, runs its Execute directly - SpawnPartisansFromUnderground(the underground's owner, province). So every ready underground in the exile's own land rises the same hour; undergrounds in an ally's land do not.

addresses.name: Underground_CanPlaceIn
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall Underground_CanPlaceIn(CMapProvince* province@ESI, CCountry* country@EDI, bool requireEmpty@stack:4) @AL

Callers: ProvinceView_PostUndergroundMission (0x6EA75B, 0x6EA856), AI_ManageUndergrounds (0x88A7A7; it inlines the same construction twice more, at 0x88A60C and 0x88A6FF) and the Lua constructor CChangeUndergroundMission(int, EUndergroundAction) (0x98A197), which no script of the base game or Their Finest Hour calls. addresses.name: CCgmSetUndergroundCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6, the custom game setup's 'Build or Destroy the underground base.' button (cgm_underground_build). The province is provinces[+0x3C]. Build (+0x40 set): the underground's level_max and level_current = 1000, underground_owner = the command's country (+0x44/+0x48), CCountry_AddUnderground, template byte +0x20 = 1. Destroy: SetProvinceBuildingLevel(province, underground, 0, false), the id off that country's list, owner '---', both levels 0, the byte. Either way the custom-game settings' +0x6C byte = 1.

addresses.name: CBuildingConstruction::Deliver
addresses.comment: Slot 9: a finished building line delivers one building. Without a target province (+0x44) and with a deployable definition (+0x60) it makes a CBuildingDeployment instead. With a province: level_max += 1000 capped at max_allowed_level*1000, CProvinceBuilding_OnLevelChanged; **for the underground** (definition == g_CBuildingDataBase +0x28) level_current += Underground_GetInitialStrength(province, builder), capped, underground_owner = the builder (+0x48/+0x4C), CCountry_AddUnderground, template byte +0x20 = 1. Then BUILDING_DONE (NAME, PROV) goes to the player **only where the player controls the province** (+0x338) - for an underground, the occupier. The rest of the body (the tech gain at the top, the count and the requeue at the end) was read only by decompile.
addresses.evidence: The underground branch and the message gate on the listing (0x485CFE-0x485DD3, 0x485E6A `cmp [ecx+0xc34], [province+0x338]`). The name is the slot's: slot 9 is CMilitaryConstruction::Deliver (confirmed) and CConvoyConstruction::Deliver in the same family; inferred because the whole body was not read on the listing.

BUILDING_DONE goes to the player where he controls the province.
addresses.evidence: The underground branch on the listing 0x57E720-0x57E7A4 (`call 0x509230`, the owner stores, `call 0x50a030` with ESI = the country); the rest by decompile. Named after CUnitDeployment::DeployAt, the same slot of the sibling class; ret 4 at 0x57ED78.

addresses.name: AI_ManageUndergrounds
addresses.comment: **The AI's use of undergrounds**, from ProcessAI (0x8895C8), so hourly for every AI country. Not for REB, the player's country, or a country with no underground. Groups the country's undergrounds by their province's COwnerArea (+0x2B4). Per area with provinces: score = 0; where 0x47FD90(area) holds, for each front (CAreaBorder on +0x74): C = the controller of its first province not held by its owner; L = the owner of the first neighbour of that province which its owner controls and which is at war with C - none ends the walk; a front with L at war with the AI's own tag (the CEU3AI argument's +0x20, taken to be the country) is skipped; strengths (unit slot 27) are summed for units friendly to C and to L over the front's provinces; where L's sum is above 0 and C's is below 1.1 times it the front is skipped; else score += (C - L) * 100 / 1000, times 1.5 where the area's controller is this country. score <= 1000; t = 1000 - score. Spread when n / min(area provinces, 200) < (20 + 20 * t / 1000) / 1000 (2 to 4 percent, compared in 15-bit fixed point): every underground of the area not on action 1 gets CChangeUndergroundMission(id, 1). Otherwise ready = those at or above SPAWN_PARTISAN_LIMIT (or the bypass byte); ready < n * t / 1000 sets the others to 2 (wait), else every one to 0 (mobilise).
addresses.evidence: The decisions and the three postings on the listing (0x88A3B7-0x88A480 the interpolation and fixed-point compare, 0x88A492-0x88A556 the ready count, the posting loops at 0x88A564, 0x88A658 and 0x88A74F with `cmp [eax+0x394], 0/2/1`), the constants floor(20.5f)=20, floor(40.5f)=40, floor(1100.5f), floor(100.5f), floor(1500.5f), floor(1000.5f) read from .rdata. Inferred because 0x47FD90 and unit slot 27 were not read, so what the score measures is a reading of shape.

addresses.name: ProvinceView_PostUndergroundMission
addresses.comment: The underground_mission button's command: CChangeUndergroundMission(province, frame - 1). One province: the view's. Several selected: each with an underground (level_max > 0) owned by the player. The button's two handlers (0x6EA380 forward, 0x6EA490 backward) step its frame 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1, so frame 1 is action 0 (partisans), 2 is action 1 (spread), 3 is action 2 (none).
addresses.evidence: Decompile checked on the listing: `call 0x55c8d0` at 0x6EA75B/0x6EA856 with `param_2 - 1`; `ret 8`. The step logic at 0x6EA44E-0x6EA45A (frame < 3 ? frame + 1 : 1) and 0x6EA55E-0x6EA56A (frame > 1 ? frame - 1 : 3). Which mouse button each handler is bound to was not read.

addresses.name: MapProvince_UpdateUndergroundIcon
addresses.comment: The underground's icon on the map. Nothing where level_max is below 1, or where byte +0x13D of the object at the map object's +8 is clear (taken to be the template's simulated flag). An underground of another country under fog of war that Underground_CanPlaceIn(province, the player, 0) refuses is hidden; otherwise the icon's frame is underground_action + 1 for the player's own and + 4 for anyone else's, and it is shown.

struct_fields.name: underground_provinces
struct_fields.comment: Head of the list of province ids holding the country's undergrounds (tail +0xD64, count +0xD68); nodes {id, prev, next, deleted}. **Rebuilt whole** by CCountry::RebuildNeighbours (0x4E3086) from every province, in id order, whose underground has level_max above 0 and whose underground_owner id is the country - which is how it comes back after a load, since the province loader sets only the owner tag. Added to by CCountry_AddUnderground (rva 0x10A030) and the inlined push in SpawnUndergroundFromProvince; taken from by RunDailyUndergroundPass's removal, CCountry_RemoveUnderground (Province_SetController) and CCgmSetUndergroundCommand; freed by 0x50A0C0. Walked by the underground pass, both predicates, the revolt button and its tooltip, CCountry_MobilizeAllUndergrounds and the AI.
struct_fields.evidence: The rebuild at 0x4E3086-0x4E3157 (clear, then `cmp [ecx+0x20],0; jle` and `cmp [eax+0x390], [ebx+0xca8]` per province); the province loader's underground_owner case at 0x4961F0 stores only +0x38C/+0x390; the writers by a byte search for the +0xD64/+0xD68 displacements.
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: added the daily/whole rebuild from the provinces (and so the list's order), every writer, and that a load restores it through the rebuild.

struct_fields.name: underground_action
struct_fields.comment: The underground action here, saved as `underground_action`; **2 is the default and is not written**. 0 = mobilise partisans every day the underground is ready, 1 = spread into a neighbour every day it is full, 2 (or any other) = nothing (RunDailyUndergroundPass's switch at 0x50AC4E). Written only by CChangeUndergroundMission::Execute and the loader; the player sets it with the province view's underground_mission button, the AI with AI_ManageUndergrounds. It is **not reset** when an underground is removed, made or spread into, so a new underground in a province inherits whatever the province last held. CMapProvince derives from CProvince and adds nothing at this offset.
struct_fields.evidence: Writers: `mov [edi+0x394], eax` at 0x55CA1A and the loader; no store of +0x394 in RunDailyUndergroundPass's removal, SpawnUndergroundFromProvince, CBuildingConstruction::Deliver, CBuildingDeployment::DeployAt or CCgmSetUndergroundCommand::Execute (all read on the listing).
struct_fields.revises: Comment only: the three values' meaning, the writers, and that nothing resets it.
